usage: codex_jobs.py [-h]
                     {run,status,tail,wait,watch,cancel,rate,backfill} ...

Background codex exec jobs with progress tracking

positional arguments:
  {run,status,tail,wait,watch,cancel,rate,backfill}
    run                 start a job in the background and print its id
    status              job table (running + last 24h)
    tail                progress lines of a job
    wait                block until a job finishes (exit 0 = succeeded, 1 =
                        not, 2 = timeout)
    watch               print one line per job state change (for Monitor)
    cancel              kill a job's process tree (also the leftovers of a
                        lost job)
    rate                send a model_fit_observation to GTO
    backfill            automatically rate past unrated terminal jobs

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
